title: AP2 failure: unresolved_constraint and fallback to human present
summary: A verifier cannot confirm that the agent-signed closed mandate meets the open mandate constraints, or meets an unknown constraint type. It returns unresolved_constraint, and the agent brings the user back to approve a closed mandate. This is the only step-up path in v0.2.

steps.label: Token plus open and closed Checkout Mandates
steps.detail: The agent presents a checkout it built autonomously. Here the checkout swaps the tent for a model that is not among acceptable_items, or the open mandate carries a constraint type the merchant does not know.

steps.label: Evaluate every constraint
steps.detail: The line item requirement cannot be matched. An unknown constraint type would fail the same way: verifiers must treat it as failing evaluation.

steps.label: Checkout Receipt: status Error, unresolved_constraint
steps.detail: A non-terminal error. It may signal a fallback to a directly approved closed mandate or to a non-agentic flow.

payload.content:
# Illustrative example, spec version v0.2. Decoded view; hashes and signatures shortened.
# Checkout Receipt JWT payload with an error (checkout_receipt.json).
{
  "status": "Error",
  "iss": "https://outdoor.example",
  "iat": 1791760100,
  "reference": "r4Tz...hash-of-closed-checkout-mandate",
  "error": "unresolved_constraint",
  "error_description": "Line item req_1 could not be matched by the checkout."
}

steps.label: Fall back: request approval of closed Mandate Content
steps.detail: Holding the error receipt, the agent may present a different mandate. Here it turns the flow into a human-present one and asks the user to approve the exact checkout.

steps.label: Show the exact checkout; authenticate
steps.detail: The user sees the substitute item and the price and decides.

failures.outcome: The purchase stops; the open mandate remains bounded by its exp.

steps.label: User-signed closed mandates
steps.detail: The surface signs closed mandates with user_sk, so no open-mandate constraint needs to be evaluated.

steps.label: Present the user-signed closed Checkout Mandate
steps.detail: The merchant verifies it as in the human-present flow and completes the checkout.
